#!/bin/zsh
# Replays of the saved rounds: one core and the GPU, three network sizes, merged rounds,
# then half precision (autocast) and compiling, with outputs kept for comparison.
cd /Users/home/Projects/gwRL
OUT=tmp/coordinator-rounds-2026-11-17
PY=tmp/gpu-mps-env/bin/python
TOOL=tools/replay_coordinator_rounds.py
ROUNDS=$OUT/profile.rounds.pickle
R=$OUT/replays
mkdir -p $R
run() {  # name, then the tool's options
  local name=$1; shift
  echo "== $name $(date +%H:%M:%S)"
  env -u MallocNanoZone $PY $TOOL . $ROUNDS --report $R/$name.json "$@" > $R/$name.log 2>&1 || echo "FAILED $name"
}
for size in 64x2 256x8 512x16; do
  env -u MallocNanoZone $PY $TOOL . --make-weights $R/weights-$size.pt --hidden-dim ${size%x*} --message-layers ${size#*x}
done
# One core: the rounds as saved, and merged.
run cpu-64x2-m1 --weights $R/weights-64x2.pt --outputs $R/cpu-64x2-m1.out.pickle
run cpu-64x2-m3 --weights $R/weights-64x2.pt --merge 3
run cpu-64x2-m8 --weights $R/weights-64x2.pt --merge 8
run cpu-256x8-m1 --weights $R/weights-256x8.pt --limit 200 --repeat 2
run cpu-512x16-m1 --weights $R/weights-512x16.pt --limit 100 --repeat 2
# The GPU: three sizes, the rounds as saved and merged.
for size in 64x2 256x8 512x16; do
  for merge in 1 3 8 16; do
    run mps-$size-m$merge --device mps --weights $R/weights-$size.pt --merge $merge --outputs $R/mps-$size-m$merge.out.pickle
  done
done
# Half precision under autocast, against the 32-bit outputs of the same device and merge.
for size in 64x2 256x8 512x16; do
  for merge in 1 8; do
    run mps-$size-m$merge-fp16 --device mps --weights $R/weights-$size.pt --merge $merge --autocast float16 --outputs $R/mps-$size-m$merge-fp16.out.pickle
    env -u MallocNanoZone $PY $TOOL --compare $R/mps-$size-m$merge.out.pickle $R/mps-$size-m$merge-fp16.out.pickle > $R/compare-mps-$size-m$merge-fp16.json
  done
done
run cpu-64x2-m1-bf16 --weights $R/weights-64x2.pt --autocast bfloat16 --outputs $R/cpu-64x2-m1-bf16.out.pickle
env -u MallocNanoZone $PY $TOOL --compare $R/cpu-64x2-m1.out.pickle $R/cpu-64x2-m1-bf16.out.pickle > $R/compare-cpu-64x2-m1-bf16.json
# Compiling the pass.
run cpu-64x2-m1-compiled --weights $R/weights-64x2.pt --compile --outputs $R/cpu-64x2-m1-compiled.out.pickle
env -u MallocNanoZone $PY $TOOL --compare $R/cpu-64x2-m1.out.pickle $R/cpu-64x2-m1-compiled.out.pickle > $R/compare-cpu-64x2-m1-compiled.json
for size in 64x2 256x8; do
  for merge in 1 8; do
    run mps-$size-m$merge-compiled --device mps --weights $R/weights-$size.pt --merge $merge --compile --outputs $R/mps-$size-m$merge-compiled.out.pickle
    env -u MallocNanoZone $PY $TOOL --compare $R/mps-$size-m$merge.out.pickle $R/mps-$size-m$merge-compiled.out.pickle > $R/compare-mps-$size-m$merge-compiled.json
  done
done
echo "all done $(date +%H:%M:%S)"
